page.phase: first Present observed; includes page setup before Start

knownAssetAndRuntimeBodies.scope: original assets and executable WASM only; JS modules, shader runtime, browser compilation and OS caches excluded

limitations: Browser memory API was exposed but timed out after 30 seconds; no browser-wide estimate obtained.
Resource Timing records include page setup before Start and may omit entries. Navigation document is not included in these resource-only snapshots.
Repeated module URLs are retained as separate request records; totals are not deduplicated by URL.
Memory probe run is not used for performance comparisons. Separate memory counters can overlap and must not be summed as a total.
